title: Northgate Marketplace Returns Policy
content:
**Policy.** A return of an item bought under Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee can be requested only when the request date is no later than the delivered date plus the tier's return window days. Calendar days are added to the delivered date, the day after delivery being day 1, and a request on the last day still qualifies. The units requested can never exceed the units bought less the units already refunded. The seller must answer within the program's seller return response time in business days by authorizing the return, refunding without a return, offering a partial refund where the program allows a partial refund without return, or declining with a reason; a seller may decline only a change-of-mind request outside the window or for an item not returnable as listed. Fulfilled by Northgate returns are accepted by Northgate directly, by mail or at a store where the program allows store drop-off, and are refunded when dropped off. Return shipping is paid by the party the program names for a change of mind or for a seller fault, by reason. Refunds go to the original payment. Returns go to the program's return destination, seller refunds use the program's seller refund tender, the original shipping is not refunded with a change-of-mind return on any program, and the buyer reaches the seller through the program's seller contact channel.

**Clause no longer in force.** The clause "The seller must refund within the program's seller refund time in business days after the return is delivered, the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most the program's maximum restocking percentage on an opened change-of-mind return, plus the original shipping charge where the program refunds the original shipping on a seller-fault return and the reason is a seller fault and never for a change of mind." is no longer in force as a clause of this policy; the seller refund owed on a return now follows the current Northgate Marketplace refund rules in force. The program figures it named remain the program figures.

**Time gate.** The record that counts is the delivered date on the marketplace order record of the order the request names, read before the request is accepted; the buyer's own account of when the parcel came does not replace it. The comparison is not later than: the request date may fall on, but not after, the last day of the window.

**Boundary days (hypothetical 30-day window).**

| Delivered date | Day 1 | Last day (day 30) | Request on 9 April 2031 | Request on 10 April 2031 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday 10 March 2031 | 11 March 2031 | Wednesday 9 April 2031 | qualifies | does not qualify |

**Unit ceiling (hypothetical).** On a line of 5 units bought with 2 units already refunded, a request may name at most 3 units.

superseded_clauses: The seller must refund within seller_refund_business_days business days after the return is delivered, the price of the returned units less a restocking fee of at most seller_restocking_fee_max_pct percent on an opened changed_mind return, plus the original shipping charge where shipping_refund_on_seller_fault applies to the reason and never for changed_mind.
